about.title: Quality that begins at the roots
about.paragraph1: Castle Crops is a leading import and export company specializing in sourcing and supplying the finest natural agricultural products. We take pride in delivering premium Arabian dates, extra virgin olive oil, and pickled olives to international markets.
about.paragraph2: Driven by deep industry expertise and a robust logistics network, we guarantee our products meet world-class quality and packaging standards — consistently exceeding our clients' expectations.
about.visionDesc: To become the global standard for premium agricultural exports, bridging ancient farming traditions with modern sustainability, and delivering the unparalleled quality of Arabian harvests to tables worldwide.

farms.title: Straight from the field to your table
farms.lead: We partner with elite strategic farms practicing sustainable, eco-friendly agriculture — nourished by pure water and rich soil under optimal sunlight.
farms.stat1Desc: Full oversight of hand-picking and careful sorting at every step.
farms.stat2Desc: Natural growing conditions that give every crop its authentic taste.
farms.stat3Desc: Products entirely free of harmful chemical additives.
farms.galleryTitle: Glimpses from the heart of our sustainable farms.
farms.block1Desc: Nestled in ancient oases, our date palm groves benefit from year-round sunshine and mineral-rich underground aquifers. We cultivate our dates using generations of inherited agricultural wisdom, completely free of artificial pesticides. This meticulous care yields dates of unmatched sweetness, size, and nutritional value.
farms.block2Desc: Our olive trees span vast, meticulously maintained orchards rooted in nutrient-dense soil. We employ sustainable irrigation and natural pest control to protect the local ecosystem. Harvested gently by hand, our olives are cold-pressed within hours to preserve their vibrant, peppery flavor and ultra-low acidity.
farms.block3Desc: Our state-of-the-art extraction facilities are located directly on the farms, ensuring that olives are cold-pressed within hours of harvesting. This rapid, temperature-controlled process guarantees the lowest possible acidity and locks in the robust, peppery antioxidants that define world-class Extra Virgin Olive Oil.
